AlignmentTermFit.description:
The score baselines' fit for one October Term, frozen before any decision it scores.

Every part reads only what was decided before the Term opened (taken as
1 October): the outcome transform is fitted on earlier Terms' decided
codes, the spread ``k`` on their complete lineups, and the positions are
the prior Term's from the estimate published before the Term opened
(``docs/merits-alignment-baseline.md``, *The frozen fits*). The
leaderboard reads baselines 3 and 4 for a Term's merits cells from this
entry alone, so a later code or lineup for an earlier Term never moves a
figure already scored.

contamination_risk.description: Of the `transform_decisions` codes, how many carry the contamination-risk flag: a fit resting on them is possibly optimistic
contamination_risk.title: Contamination Risk

frozen_on.description: The day the fit was computed
frozen_on.title: Frozen On

k.description: The vote model's spread, fitted by likelihood on earlier Terms' coded complete lineups at the transform; null below the fit floor or without a transform or positions, and then baseline 4 is not scored for the Term
k.title: K

k_decisions.description: Coded complete lineups the spread read
k_decisions.title: K Decisions

latest_decision_read.description: The latest merits judgment date among the decisions the fit read; before `opened`. Null when it read none
latest_decision_read.title: Latest Decision Read

opened.description: 1 October of `term`: nothing decided on or after it is read
opened.title: Opened

positions.description: Each Justice's position for the prior Term, larger more conservative, from the release published before `opened`; null where none was
positions.title: Positions

term.description: The October Term whose decisions this fit scores
term.title: Term

transform.description: The isotonic outcome transform as (lowest score in a block, the block's Laplace-smoothed rate) knots in increasing score order: a score maps to the rate of the last block starting at or below it, and a score below every block to the first's. Null below the fit floor, and then neither baseline is scored for the Term
transform.title: Transform

AlignmentTermFit.title: AlignmentTermFit

description:
``data/merits-alignment/alignment-fits.json`` — every Term's frozen score-baseline fit.

**Append-only**: a Term's fit is made once and never revised, so a publish
that would replace an entry is refused (``fedcourts alignment-fit``).
Entries are sorted by ``term``, one per Term.
